name: newspaper
title_zh: 整份报纸 PDF 拆成带话题标签的摘要库
tagline_zh: 指定页码丢进来，每篇文章都被摘成一段话、打上你 topics.txt 里的标签，落进 SQLite 再同步到网页。
tagline_en: Give it page numbers; every article gets a summary, a topic tag from your topics.txt, a SQLite row, a webapp.
desc_en: Read a newspaper PDF end to end - extract the chosen pages, summarise every article, tag them against topics.txt, store them in SQLite, publish to the PostgreSQL-backed webapp, and open an HTML reading page. Use when the user names a newspaper or e-paper PDF and wants it summarised, digested, or "read for me", optionally with page numbers (e.g. "summarise today.pdf pages 1-8,12"). Also use for "wh
why_zh: 摘要、打标、入库、发布是一条链走完的，不是只吐一段文字。
why_en: Summarise, tag, store, publish is one chain, not a text blob; topics come from your own topics.txt, not model-invented labels.
limit_zh: 只吃文本层可抽取的 PDF，扫描件没 OCR 会拿到空文章；话题标签完全依赖你提供的 topics.txt。
limit_en: Text-layer PDFs only; scanned pages without OCR yield empty articles. Tagging needs your topics.txt. Publishing needs a reachable PostgreSQL.
title_en: Turn a newspaper PDF into a tagged, searchable digest
